title: Kapija Monument - panoramio
subject: The Kapija memorial plaque with flowers
author: El Barto
required_credit_line: Photo: El Barto, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons
modifications: downloaded the 1920px-wide Commons thumbnail, resized to 1600px wide, re-encoded as JPEG (quality 85), embedded metadata dropped; no crop, no colour change
panorama_note: A memorial to the 71 young people killed by a shell at the Kapija on 1995-05-25, with their names. The plaque is a work in public space (freedom-of-panorama risk for commercial use) and, more importantly, it is a place of mourning: use only on a page that tells its story, never as decoration or on a social card.
